contexts.text: Biting the horse's heels () = to consult the lowest intellectual or scientific things, and form conclusions from them.
Biting the horse's heels = fallacies from lowest nature. To bite = to cleave to, and thus do injury.
Infestations through evils are signified by the biting of lice.
This pain is what is called the stings of conscience... (See also Conscience.)
He is bitten by serpents, that is, by infernal Spirits...
At this they bit their tongues...
A man feels this combat in himself no otherwise than as the stings of conscience.
